env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos run .
stdout '^tagged$'
go run .
stdout '^plain$'

cd exp
logos run .
stdout '^arena$'
go run .
stdout '^noarena$'
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm
logos list -f '{{.GoFiles}}' .
stdout 'arena_on\.go'
stdout 'preempt_on\.go'
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
cd ../expnoarena
logos run .
stdout '^noarena$'
cd ..

-- go.mod --
module example.com/tagdiff

go 1.27

-- main.go --
//go:build !logos

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("plain")
}

-- tag_logos.go --
//go:build logos

package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("tagged")
}

-- exp/go.mod --
module example.com/tagexp

go 1.27

-- exp/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(tag())
}

-- exp/arena_on.go --
//go:build goexperiment.logosarena

package main

func tag() string { return "arena" }

-- exp/arena_off.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.logosarena

package main

func tag() string { return "noarena" }

-- exp/preempt_on.go --
//go:build goexperiment.preemptibleloops

package main

func preempt() string { return "preempt" }

-- exp/preempt_off.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.preemptibleloops

package main

func preempt() string { return "nopreempt" }

-- expnoarena/go.mod --
module example.com/tagnoarena

go 1.27

-- expnoarena/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false

-- expnoarena/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(tag())
}

-- expnoarena/arena_on.go --
//go:build goexperiment.logosarena

package main

func tag() string { return "arena" }

-- expnoarena/arena_off.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.logosarena

package main

func tag() string { return "noarena" }
